descriptionByLocale.en: Spitex Birseck is a forward-looking, progressive non-profit organization. On behalf of the municipalities of Munichstein and Arlesheim, we provide professional and comprehensive care and support so that our clients can live independently at home. We are looking for an experienced and motivated personality as a Dipl from now on or by agreement. Nursing professional in ambulatory care, 20% - 100% Your benefits: Flexible working hours Attractive allowances/expenses Regulation Permanent employment contract 5 weeks Holiday Strong and helpful team Assumption of further education and a wide range of apprenticeship places Appreciative company culture Children's allowances Plus health promotion measures ... and much more Dipl. Nursing specialist in outpatient care, 20% - 100% Your tasks Multifaceted everyday life in outpatient care self-responsible design High care quality ensure connecting link between employees, the management and other specialists guide colleagues and support in daily work Interdisciplinary cooperation and coordination with external bodies Possibility to take over the case management and the case responsibility Dipl. Nursing professional HF or FH work experience in outpatient care Motivation, moving new things and getting proven Open, communicative and empathetic way in dealing with colleagues, clients and relatives driving license Cat. B or joy of cycling Your prospects With us you can expect a responsible and varied activity with meaning. You can contribute your strengths, take responsibility and make a difference. Look forward to a motivated team that moves forward together and warmly welcomes you. Do you have any questions? Please contact us. We look forward to receiving your complete application documents by email personal@spitex-birseck.ch
